topic: What happens if you swallow chewing gum
canonical_en: What happens if you swallow chewing gum?
title: What Really Happens If You Swallow Gum?
description: Does gum really stay in your stomach for seven years? Here is the real journey.
facts_checked: Gum base is not digested but usually passes through in a few days -> mayoclinic.org

scenes.line: What happens if you swallow your chewing gum?
scenes.visual: [GUY] freezing mid-gulp, eyes wide, a pink gum ball visible in his open mouth

scenes.line: Everyone says it stays inside you for seven years.
scenes.visual: a pink gum ball sitting in a tiny armchair inside a cosy stomach-shaped room with a calendar flipping pages

scenes.line: First, it slides down your esophagus like a pink submarine.
scenes.visual: cartoon cutaway of [GUY]'s throat with a pink gum ball sliding down the food pipe

scenes.line: Then it splashes into your stomach acid.
scenes.visual: gum ball splashing into a bubbling green pool inside a cartoon stomach

scenes.line: The sugar and flavour dissolve almost instantly.
scenes.visual: close-up of the gum ball fizzing as colourful sugar sparkles float away from it

scenes.line: But the rubbery gum base? Your body cannot break it down.
scenes.visual: simple 3D diagram: a grey rubbery blob surrounded by tiny enzyme characters bouncing off it

scenes.line: So your gut just pushes it along with everything else.
scenes.visual: cartoon cutaway of winding intestines squeezing the grey blob forward like a conveyor belt

scenes.line: A few days later, it leaves the building.
scenes.visual: the grey blob wearing tiny sunglasses walking out of an exit door with a glowing EXIT shape

scenes.line: Seven years was a myth all along.
scenes.visual: [GUY] laughing with relief, holding a torn calendar page

scenes.line: Still, maybe don't swallow a whole pack at once.
scenes.visual: [GUY] looking guilty at a pile of empty gum wrappers on the floor
